title: Gcd property-test policy
description: Acceptance criteria are checked empirically: property-tested evidence on the sampled domain accepts them. The contract clauses (GCD-01..GCD-04) stay with the Dafny backend and its own policy; the two reports never mix.

rules.rationale: An acceptance criterion is an empirical claim: a deterministic sample of inputs is the evidence the set asks for (property-tested), never a proof.
